items.q: Why hasn't prompt injection been patched?
items.a: The model does not cleanly split **your** instruction from text **someone else** put in what it just read. A blocklist loses to a different command. A second LLM babysitter is dumb in the same way.
Host on Anthropic's hidden-context babysitter: about **99%**. Fine for a spam filter. Not fine for an agent that can put a database on a leak site.

items.q: What does OpenAPA copy from classified rooms?
items.a: Material stays in a room rated for it. Nothing read there leaves. After a **private read**, the session is private. A public GitHub issue is a lower room, so the call stops until a human signs off.

items.q: Why can't a clever prompt talk its way through?
items.a: The proxy sits **between Claude Code and its tools**, outside the agent loop. It does not score the prompt. Nvidia's version is a second processor. Archestra's is a TOML file.

items.q: What did the host's head-to-head show?
items.a: The proxy **blocked the exfil** and finished **75%** of jobs. Claude Code auto mode finished up to **96%**. Tokens went up. Still preview, MIT, few stars.
